attributes.action: Make the Rugby League World Cup 2026 Free to Air on the BBC
attributes.additional_details:
The Rugby League World Cup will be broadcast exclusively on the subscription channel Premier Sports later this year, after the BBC opted against renewing its coverage.
​While the BBC has historically been the primary home for international rugby league—most recently broadcasting all three Ashes Tests last year—this shift marks a major departure from tradition, moving the tournament off free-to-air television

I think this is shameful lack of respect to the global game and insulting to the fans.
attributes.background: The UK governent should review this decision and make the RLWC 2026 free to air on the BBC , capturing a much larger audience and ensuring it cant prejudice people who cant afford it in a cost of living crisis
